title: Period and Graph of y = cos(pi*x/2)
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Find the fundamental period of the function y = \cos(\pi x / 2) and list its key graphical landmarks over one cycle.

steps.title: Compute the Period
steps.explanation: Divide 2*pi by the coefficient pi/2 of x to find the fundamental period B = 4.
steps.why: The argument pi*x/2 advances by 2*pi when x advances by 4.

steps.title: Identify the Amplitude and Range
steps.explanation: The amplitude is 1 and the vertical range is [-1, 1].
steps.why: The multiplier in front of cosine is 1.

steps.title: List Quarter-Period Points on [0, 4]
steps.explanation: Each quarter-period has length 4/4 = 1, giving maxima at x = 0 and x = 4, zeros at x = 1 and x = 3, and a minimum of -1 at x = 2.
steps.why: Substituting x = 0, 1, 2, 3, 4 yields the standard quadrantal values of cosine.
